title: Tyler Files Administrative Complaint
description: Tyler submitted administrative complaint with all required documentation, exhausting administrative remedies as required by law.

title: Administrative Remedies Exhausted
description: All administrative remedies completed as documented in Exhibit A of ECF 8. Tyler provided proof of completion to all relevant parties.

title: Tyler Files Opposition Brief
description: Tyler files comprehensive opposition to defendant's motion to dismiss, including three exhibits proving exhaustion of remedies.

title: DDA Files Response Brief
description: DDA files response claiming Tyler never exhausted administrative remedies, contrary to evidence in ECF 8 and ECF 36.

title: West Linn Files Response
description: West Linn Police Department files response asserting qualified immunity defense.

title: Tyler Files Declaration
description: Tyler submits sworn declaration with three exhibits proving exhaustion of administrative remedies, directly contradicting DDA's claims.

title: Magistrate Beckerman Issues ECF 60 Order
description: Magistrate Beckerman issues order containing multiple negative findings against Tyler, many contradicting evidence in the record.

title: Initial Complaint Filed
description: Tyler files initial complaint in federal court after exhausting all administrative remedies.

title: Defendants File Motion to Dismiss
description: Defendants file coordinated motions to dismiss, claiming various procedural deficiencies.

title: Tyler Files Reply Brief
description: Tyler files reply brief responding to defendants' mischaracterizations and providing additional evidence.
